about: What happened after each aggressor event, checked by the runtime (tessera-market orderflow::big_trades OutcomeWatch) and the desk (@tessera/chart flow/outcome) alike. Prints are [t, price, size, side] as in aggregate.json and join into events by the default grouping. Every event with a side gets an outcome [t, side, size, kind, decided]: the first print after its last print (strictly later in time) decides it. pushed: the print is reachTicks ticks or more past the event's far price its way (its highest for a buy, its lowest for a sell). absorbed: the print is reachTicks ticks or more back past its average price, against it. neither: the first print more than 60 s after its last print, decided at 60 s. kind and decided are null when no print decides it before the prints end.

cases.name: a buy sweep is pushed by a later print 2 ticks over its highest price
a sell sweep is absorbed by a later print 2 ticks back over its average price
a print exactly 60 s after the last one still decides
the first print past 60 s settles neither, at 60 s, whatever its price
a print at the event's last time is not later than it
the reach is the case's ticks
a print without a side moves the price too, and is never an event to decide
